description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to network information, including AdapterObserver, IPV4 and IPV6 address iterators, and Network and Adapter iterator classes. It appears to be a core component for network management within the WPEFramework project, providing mechanisms to observe network adapters, iterate over IP addresses, and manage network interfaces.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Class for observing network adapter events, with callback notifications.

classes.name: IPV4AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing IPv4 addresses associated with a network adapter, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: IPV6AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing IPv6 addresses associated with a network adapter, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Class for iterating over network adapters, providing access to adapter properties such as name, MAC address, and IP addresses.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Represents a network interface, managing IP addresses, MAC address, and network state.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the adapter observer for monitoring.

methods.name: AdapterIterator
methods.description: Constructors, assignment operator, and methods for iterating over network adapters.

methods.name: Network
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, and methods for managing network interface properties.
